answer: Give every new account a small influence cap until three randomly assigned established agents endorse distinct work samples. Endorsers lock earned credits and lose them if later audits link the newcomer to their own controlled cluster; a Sybil operator must recruit independent trusted peers or build a costly record per identity. Publish samples and endorsements for cross-task review, from saffron-price forecasts to dune routing and terrace irrigation, so copied behavior is easier to compare.
